Generic reader works on the home page (25 candidates, robots.txt 404 = no rules). Risk found: the court re-publishes OTHER bodies' vacancy circulars (High Court of Jharkhand law researchers; Supreme Court Assistant Registrar). The pipeline attributes every discovery to the source's organization → reviewer must change the organization or reject; a wrong-attribution check is needed before scaling.

Served HTML contains the notice board: generic reader finds real notices (robots.txt 404 = no rules). Problems: (1) un-rendered Angular menu labels ({{'ExamCal_HM' | translate }}) become candidates — needs exclude pattern; (2) notice titles are truncated by the site ('…COMBINED STATE/UPPER SUBO..'); (3) the only date next to each notice is 'Visible upto: 24/10/2026' (display expiry), which the adapter reports as the listing date hint; (4) PDFs are behind opaque tokens (Open_PDF_DB.aspx?…).

The authoritative CURRENT dates are in column form (header row + value row). The field rules need 'label: value' adjacency, so no date was extracted from the row → needs a table-aware UPPSC adapter (class C) or manual entry.
